HomePage.title: A-frame House with Hot Tub, Zhytomyr Region | EcoHouse Strieva
HomePage.description: A-frame house with a Transcarpathian hot tub near Zviahel, Zhytomyr region, Ukraine. Terrace, grill area, river nearby. Nightly rental for two or a group of up to 4.
HomePage.logoAlt: EcoHouse Strieva — house with a hot tub
HomePage.h1: A-frame house with a hot tub near Zviahel, Zhytomyr region
HomePage.h2: Rent a house with a hot tub
HomePage.h2p1: Renting an A-frame house with a Carpathian hot tub by the river is the best vacation option for you!
HomePage.h2p2: Located in the village of Strieva, this unique architectural gem with high ceilings and panoramic windows creates an unparalleled sense of space and harmony with nature. Here, every sunrise fills the air with crystal-clear freshness, and evenings bring the warmth of fire and a starry sky you can gaze at right from the living room. It’s the perfect place for those seeking tranquility, comfort, and unforgettable impressions combined with modern style and coziness.
HomePage.h2p3: A small house with a hot tub for two is a chance to enjoy nature, wake up to birdsong, breathe in the scent of forest and flowers, and take a break from city noise and the hustle of everyday life. Here you can feel in tune with nature, savor every moment, spend time with family and friends, and enjoy the Carpathian hot tub.
HomePage.h2p4: Regardless of the season, EcoHouse Strieva will be your ideal hideaway to escape the city hustle.
HomePage.h3: House with hot tub for rent: amenities
HomePage.h3p1: Convenient location near the city of Zviahel
HomePage.h3p3: Cozy, green plot by the river
HomePage.h3p5: Transcarpathian hot tub, bonfire and grill area
HomePage.h3ul: The main feature is the hot tub located on the terrace, but you will also find in the house:
HomePage.h3li1: Bedding, towels, slippers, bathrobes for all guests;
HomePage.h3li2: Spices, tea, coffee, sugar, oil, filtered water;
HomePage.h3li3: Full set of dishes, glasses, stove and refrigerator;
HomePage.h3li5: Unlimited use of the hot tub on your terrace and firewood;
HomePage.h3li6: Bonfire, grill area and everything you need for grilling;
HomePage.h3li7: Personal autonomous power supply in case of a power outage;
HomePage.h3li8: Energy-independent internet (if the power is out for more than 5 minutes, please inform the administrator).
HomePage.orderLikeText: Hurry up! The daily rental of the house is in high demand, especially on holidays and weekends.
HomePage.h32: Rental prices for the house with a hot tub
HomePage.tableRow1note: Price for 2 people/1 night. Additional guests are paid separately. Maximum 4 adults.
HomePage.tableRow2note: Price per day. Unlimited, no add-ons.
HomePage.tableRow4note: When using charcoal — free of charge. Charcoal can be purchased on site.
HomePage.tableRow5li1: 300 UAH - Healing herb mix for the tub: nettle, linden blossom, thyme, dandelion root, mint, buckthorn bark, birch leaf, bur-marigold, chamomile;
HomePage.tableRow5li2: 250 UAH - Citrus tub: orange and grapefruit;
HomePage.tableRow5li4: 600 UAH - Milk tub with citrus (orange, grapefruit).
HomePage.tableRow6note: Booking is made with a mandatory 50% prepayment. Maximum number of adults is 4. Check-in 15:00. Check-out 11:00.
HomePage.h33: How to get here and book
HomePage.address2: 37 Peremohy Street, Strieva village, Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine, 11777, Tel: +38-097-017-37-37
HomePage.address2p: EcoHouse Strieva is more than just a small house with a hot tub. It’s a place where unforgettable memories are made and harmony and peace of mind are restored. Renting a house with a hot tub from us means giving yourself and your loved ones a unique vacation you’ll want to repeat!

questions.a0: Our chalet with a hot tub is located in Zhytomyr Oblast, in the village of Strieva, not far from the city of Zviahel (Novograd-Volynskyi).
questions.q2: When are there available dates for renting the house with a hot tub?
questions.a2: To find out available dates, contact us by phone at +38-097-017-37-37 or submit a request on the website.
questions.q3: For how many people is the stay in the house with a hot tub designed?
questions.a3: The stay in our house with a hot tub is designed for 4 people.
questions.q4: Is the amount of firewood for heating the tub limited?
questions.a4: An unlimited amount of firewood for the tub is included in the rental price.
questions.q5: What hot tub add-ons do you offer?
questions.a5: You can order add-ons for the tub: a healing herb mix (nettle, linden blossom, thyme, dandelion root, mint, buckthorn bark, birch leaf, bur-marigold, chamomile), citrus (orange and grapefruit), milk, or milk with citrus. Current prices are in the “Hot tub add-ons” table above.
questions.a6: Yes, you can purchase a gift certificate from 5000 UAH!
questions.q7: Can the barbecue be fired with firewood?
questions.a7: The barbecue runs only on charcoal (we provide it for an additional fee).
questions.a8: Yes, we have a generator that will provide electricity in case of a power outage.
questions.a9: Yes, you can bring pets (up to 10 kg free of charge), but they must be supervised.
